sampling: Deterministic hash order of raw prediction IDs, stratified by channel; select 16 per channel (32 minimum), then a separately labelled diagnostic supplement only if fewer than 16 selected forecasts have a mature, falsifiable endpoint. No sampling on prior HIT/MISS/PARTIAL.
horizon_rule: Use the speaker's explicit date or duration measured from video publication. A conditional/no-date narrative is UNSCORABLE unless an unambiguous finite endpoint is specified. Do not silently invent a 3-month horizon for vague 'soon' or 'eventually'. End-of-quarter/year means actual last calendar day. Unmatured endpoints remain PENDING, never failed.
evidence_rule: Read raw wording and transcript context when needed. Attribution, hypothetical scenarios and quoted forecasts remain distinguished from personal unconditional forecasts. Policy/geopolitical outcomes without independent primary dated evidence are CANNOT_VERIFY, not market-data hits.
direction_rule: For explicit up/down directions, compare last observation available at publication with the last observation by the specified endpoint. Deadband: 0.5% for asset-price/index levels and relative performance; 0.10 percentage points for yields/inflation/unemployment; 1% for aggregate stocks/flows. These are fixed simple tolerances, not optimized. Correct directional category is HIT; wrong or flat is MISS. PARTIAL only for an explicitly separable conjunction with some but not all components fulfilled, otherwise disallow.
target_rule: Explicit price targets use the target itself with no ad hoc tolerance. 'Reach/touch' means observed threshold crossing before deadline; 'at/end' means endpoint. Missing horizon/conditional condition not observed is UNSCORABLE/PENDING_CONDITION. Ambiguous target metric is UNSCORABLE.
calendar_and_vintage: Calendar-aligned CPI YoY; incomplete or missing observation months are not interpolated. Supplied histories are revised and exact release timestamps often unavailable, so label dated-source reconstruction as approximate. For monthly releases, use observation month ending before the forecast or target date and flag unknown release availability.
paired_nulls: For direction-only mature single-metric forecasts, compare identical rows/outcomes to (1) NO_CHANGE = neutral/flat within same deadband; (2) PERSISTENCE = direction over the preceding 30 calendar days for daily prices/rates, or preceding 3 observation months for monthly macro rates. Null HIT iff its predicted category equals actual category. Exclude unscorable/pending/unverified and explicit reach/path targets from paired null universe rather than changing its denominator.
comparison: Lock independent labels to disk before joining legacy scored outcomes. Report agreement, changes, exclusions and paired sample n; report selected cohort versus diagnostic supplement separately. Broad S&P buy-and-hold return is an unpaired opportunity-cost illustration, not a forecaster accuracy null. No investable portfolio underperformance claim without stated execution, capital weighting, holdings, costs and full call coverage.
bias_limits: One independent human-like reader, small deterministic sample, shared supplied data and imperfect vintages. Strictness tests scoring robustness, not a representative causal estimate of channel quality or premium content. Keep all exclusions visible.
